Method of Attack: Injecting malicious JavaScript skimmer script into eCommerce or checkout pages to steal submitted credit card and payment information
Discoverer: Troy Mursch of Bad Packets Report
Impacted Systems: Legitimate website collecting donations for Australia bushfires
Attack Vector: Compromise of website and injection of malicious JavaScript skimmer script into checkout pages
Indicators of Compromise: vamberlo[.]com domain (used to receive stolen payment information)
